js: 'Chat voice WP7, live: dictation by Right Ctrl into the composer (a tap and Right Ctrl+C open nothing), a held mouse press records, Enter sends it as a spoken turn with its mic badge, the speaker reads a stored reply to its end, read replies aloud (in the voice menu) starts the speech before the text is done and lets the next send through, and under the GPU hold the CPU speech-to-text keeps serving while the text-to-speech is said refused before anything is spoken. A dev copy (scripts/dev-copy.sh) with a local CPU speech-to-text (audio/parakeet-tdt-q8-0), a local text-to-speech (audio/supertonic-3-q8-0, no hold fallback) and a small local chat model (gemma4-e4b) — it starts their containers, so it runs with --podman-guard "": check `podman ps -a --filter name=lmgw-dev` afterwards and stop the dev copy. Run: scripts/ui-drive.py scripts/drive/chat-voice-dictation.json --token-file <dir>.token --fake-mic <a TTS-generated German WAV of about 7 s> --podman-guard "" (playback is muted).'
